body.statement: If \(\mathsf{UGC}\) holds, then for every fixed \(\epsilon>0\), Minimum Vertex Cover has no polynomial-time \(2-\epsilon\)-approximation.

source.locator: Abstract and Section 4, specialized to graphs
source.verbatim_statement: For the case \(k=2\) we obtain a \(2-\epsilon\) hardness result for vertex cover.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the graph specialization in the introduction, with typographic mathematical symbols rendered in LaTeX.
